The number of vehicles in the Unit is one Softskin Transport for each Team in the Unit.

Special Rules
Tractor: Team can carry one Gun Team as Passengers.

Softskin: If a Transport is Destroyed, any Passengers it is carrying are also Destroyed, and Unit immediately Dismounts and all of its Transports are Sent to the Rear.
All Passengers must Dismount from this Unit at the sametime. Empty Transport Teams must be Sent to the Rear.

Unarmoured: Team cannot Charge into Contact and must Break Off if Assaulted.

sharedRules.name: Not One Step Back
sharedRules.description: Units with Not One Step Back have a better Last Stand rating

sharedRules.name: Flame-Thrower
sharedRules.description:
Infantry, Gun, and Unarmoured Tank Teams re-roll successfulSaves when hit by a Flame-thrower, and the Unit isautomatically Pinned Down. Armoured Tank Teams use theirTop armour for Armour Saves when hit by a Flame-thrower.

Flame-throwers may shoot in Defensive Fire. However, whilea Unit that is Hit by a Flame-thrower is Pinned Down, thisdoes not automatically stop the assault. The defender stillneeds to score five (or eight) hits as normal to stop the assault.

sharedRules.name: Crafty
sharedRules.description: Crafty Tanks have a better Tactics ratings.

sharedRules.name: Flammable
sharedRules.description: Flammable Tanks have a worse Motivation and Assault ratings.

sharedRules.name: Heavy Tank
sharedRules.description: Heavy Tanks have a better Counterattack rating.

sharedRules.name: Turret-Rear MG
sharedRules.description: Tanks with a Turret-Rear MG have a better Assault rating.

sharedRules.name: For the Motherland
sharedRules.description: Infantry with For the Motherland have a better Assault rating.

sharedRules.name: Kommisar
sharedRules.description: While their Kommisar team is In Command, a Unit has a better Motivation, as shown in the Kommisar column on the Unit Card.

sharedRules.name: Unit Transport
sharedRules.description: The Unit Leader of the Transport Attachment must end the Movement Step within 6”/15cm of the Unit Leader of its Passenger Unit while on table. If it cannot do this, then the Transport Attachment must be Sent to the Rear (see page 45 of the rulebook).

sharedRules.name: Urrah
sharedRules.description: Units with Urrah may move 6"/15cm (instead of 4"/10cm) when Charging into Contact.

sharedRules.name: Salvo
sharedRules.description:
Weapons with a ROF of 'salvo' are Artillery weapons and fire Artillery Bombardments, but use a 10"/25cm square Salvo Template rather than the normal 6"/15cm Artillery Template.

A Salvo Template may not be placed within 6"/15cm of a friendly Team.

sharedRules.name: Flying Tank
sharedRules.description: Flying Tanks have a worse Is Hit On rating, but a better Save.
